behavioral_notes.element: stock.picking._send_confirmation_email override (the actual SMS trigger on delivery validation)
behavioral_notes.observation: The SMS is sent from the override of stock._send_confirmation_email, which the parent stock module calls inside _action_done (stock_picking.py:1279) -- i.e. AFTER a delivery is fully validated (button_validate -> _pre_action_done_hook==True -> _action_done -> _send_confirmation_email). The override super()s (keeping the email branch) then, unless context skip_sms or modules.module.current_test, filters self to pickings where picking.company_id._get_text_validation('sms') AND picking_type_id.code=='outgoing' AND picking.partner_id.phone, and for each calls picking._message_sms_with_template(template=company.sudo().stock_sms_confirmation_template_id, partner_ids=picking.partner_id.ids, put_in_queue=False). So the real trigger is 'outgoing delivery order with a customer phone is validated, with company SMS confirmation enabled'; the template is sudo()-read because the validating user may lack sms.template rights, and put_in_queue=False means the sms.sms is sent immediately (synchronously through the sms IAP gateway), not batched.

The on/off switch is NOT a field named stock_move_sms_validation -- it is the parent stock res.company pair stock_text_confirmation (Boolean) + stock_confirmation_type (Selection [('sms','SMS')]); _get_text_validation('sms') returns bool(stock_text_confirmation and stock_confirmation_type=='sms') (stock/models/res_company.py:213). stock_sms only ADDS stock_sms_confirmation_template_id (M2M-domain to sms.template on model stock.picking, default = sms_template_data_stock_delivery) and has_received_warning_stock_sms (Boolean, the 'user already saw the SMS warning' flag). res.config.settings re-exposes the template as a related field, and the settings view xpath reveals the template picker + IAP buy-credits widget only when stock_confirmation_type=='sms' and stock_text_confirmation. The post_init_hook _assign_default_sms_template_picking_id turns the feature ON for companies lacking a template (sets stock_text_confirmation=True + the default template); the uninstall_hook _reset_sms_text_confirmation turns it back OFF.

Before the SMS ever fires, the override of _pre_action_done_hook (called by button_validate at stock_picking.py:1414, before _action_done) inserts a guard: if super() returned True and context has no skip_sms, _check_warn_sms collects outgoing pickings with a partner phone and SMS validation enabled WHERE company.has_received_warning_stock_sms is still False and not modules.module.current_test; if any, it returns _action_generate_warn_sms_wizard -- an ir.actions.act_window opening the confirm.stock.sms (target='new') wizard carrying pick_ids and the surrounding context (which includes button_validate_picking_ids set by the parent button_validate at line 1413). Returning an action from _pre_action_done_hook aborts the validation and pops the modal instead. So the FIRST time a company uses delivery SMS the user is asked to confirm; thereafter has_received_warning_stock_sms suppresses the prompt.

The wizard has two buttons. send_sms(): sets has_received_warning_stock_sms=True (sudo) on each picking's company so the prompt never reappears, then re-runs button_validate on env['stock.picking'].browse(context['button_validate_picking_ids']) -- this second pass has the warning flag set so _check_warn_sms returns empty and validation proceeds to _action_done -> _send_confirmation_email -> the SMS. dont_send_sms(): also sets has_received_warning_stock_sms=True AND writes stock_text_confirmation=False on the company (globally disabling delivery SMS), then re-validates -- now _get_text_validation('sms') is False so no SMS is sent. Both paths converge on button_validate of the same pickings via the context key set upstream by stock.button_validate. This is the human-confirmation handshake metadata cannot show.

data/sms_data.xml defines the default sms.template 'Delivery: Send by SMS Text Message' (noupdate=1) on model stock.picking. Its body renders, per recipient picking object: '<company name>: We are glad to inform you that your order n° <origin> has been shipped.' (or '...your order has been shipped.' when object.origin is empty), and APPENDS ' Your tracking reference is <carrier_tracking_ref>.' only when hasattr(object,'carrier_tracking_ref') and it is set (the carrier_tracking_ref field exists only if stock_delivery/a carrier module is installed, so the hasattr guard keeps the template safe without it). Rendering goes through sms.template's mail.render.mixin against the stock.picking record; the company default is wired by _default_confirmation_sms_picking_template / the post_init hook.

it_architecture.application: stock_sms (Stock - SMS -- sends a delivery-shipped SMS to the customer when an outgoing picking is validated)
software_services: (no HTTP routes) -- behavior is server-side: stock.picking validation hooks + the confirm.stock.sms wizard action
logical_data_erm: sms.template body rendered against stock.picking (origin, company_id.name, carrier_tracking_ref?)
information_flows: side-effect: button_validate -> _pre_action_done_hook (override) -> _check_warn_sms -> (first time) confirm.stock.sms wizard; else proceed

side-effect: _action_done -> _send_confirmation_email (override) -> outgoing pickings with partner phone + SMS enabled -> _message_sms_with_template (put_in_queue=False) -> sms.sms sent immediately via sms IAP
side-effect: confirm.stock.sms.send_sms -> set company.has_received_warning_stock_sms=True -> re-run button_validate (now sends SMS)
side-effect: confirm.stock.sms.dont_send_sms -> company.stock_text_confirmation=False -> re-run button_validate (SMS globally off)
config: post_init_hook _assign_default_sms_template_picking_id enables feature + default template; uninstall_hook _reset_sms_text_confirmation disables it

external_integrations.notes: No own outbound HTTP/SDK. The actual SMS delivery (and IAP credit consumption) happens in the base sms module's IAP layer (sms.sms.send -> SmsApi -> https://sms.api.odoo.com); stock_sms only produces the sms.sms via _message_sms_with_template. The settings view embeds the sms IAP buy-credits widget. uses_api_keys=false.

classification.apqc_category: 4.0 Deliver Physical Products (4.4 Operate outbound transportation / ship)
classification.rationale: stock_sms attaches to the outbound-logistics primary activity of the inventory value chain (Porter / Stabell & Fjeldstad): its sole trigger is validation of an OUTGOING stock.picking (button_validate -> _action_done -> _send_confirmation_email), i.e. the moment goods physically ship to the customer -- the same 4.4 'Operate outbound transportation / ship' step that the parent stock and stock_delivery occupy in this corpus. value_model is therefore chain (it rides the goods-flow/shipment transformation), NOT network: unlike the cross-cutting base sms gateway (classified support / 9.4 internal communications because it is generic messaging infrastructure), stock_sms is a specific, delivery-bound shipment notification with no audience/mediation semantics of its own. apqc_category 4.0 Deliver Physical Products (4.4 ship/outbound) matches the name and the trigger. activity_class is support (mirroring stock_delivery in this corpus): the SMS is an ancillary customer-notification step layered onto the delivery -- it informs the customer but does not itself move or transform the goods (the stock.move ledger is untouched by this module), so it supports rather than performs the deliver value stream. It is classed under Deliver (4.x), not under the sms module's 9.4 communications code, because the message is an integral confirmation event of the shipment, not a standalone internal-comms channel.

standard_capabilities: Automatic SMS to the customer when an outgoing delivery order is validated
Default delivery SMS template (company name + order origin + optional carrier tracking ref)
Per-company SMS template configurable from Inventory Settings (gated by the stock text-confirmation toggle)
First-use confirmation wizard (Confirm / Disable SMS / Cancel) to avoid surprise charges
Immediate (non-queued) send through the sms IAP gateway, with the buy-credits widget in settings
Stock-manager-scoped editing of delivery SMS templates via a record rule
post_init auto-enable with default template; clean uninstall reset
typical_fits: 'Your order has been shipped' SMS to B2C / e-commerce customers on dispatch
Adding a tracking reference to the shipment SMS when a carrier (stock_delivery) is installed
Companies wanting delivery confirmations without writing automation rules
common_gaps: Fires only on the outgoing picking_type and only when partner_id.phone is set (no fallback to mobile-only contacts unless phone resolves)
No per-customer / per-order opt-out for this transactional SMS (it is not marketing opt-out aware)
Single delivery template per company (no per-warehouse / per-carrier template selection out of box)
Synchronous send (put_in_queue=False) -- a slow/failing IAP call happens inside validation
Depends on Odoo IAP SMS credits/country support; non-Odoo providers need the base sms gateway customization
drive_hints: odoo shell: env.company.write({'stock_text_confirmation':True,'stock_confirmation_type':'sms'}); env.company._get_text_validation('sms')  # enable + verify gate
odoo shell: env.ref('stock_sms.sms_template_data_stock_delivery').body  # the delivery SMS body template
odoo shell: p=env['stock.picking'].search([('picking_type_id.code','=','outgoing'),('state','=','assigned')],limit=1); p.with_context(skip_sms=False).button_validate()  # triggers the wizard/SMS path
odoo shell: env['sms.sms'].search([], order='id desc', limit=5).mapped(('number','state','body'))  # SMS produced by deliveries

open_questions: Live counts of delivery SMS sent / IAP credit consumption were not captured (runtime models_with_data=0) and require an activated IAP account.
Behavior when partner_id has only a mobile (not phone) field set -- the gate checks partner_id.phone specifically, so mobile-only contacts may be skipped depending on phone resolution.
Interaction with multi-step delivery routes (pick/pack/ship): whether the SMS fires on the final 'ship' picking only is governed by which outgoing picking type is validated, not enforced here.
